Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer incorrectly identified King Edward VII as the monarch responsible for the 1925 Birthday Honours. King Edward VII had passed away in 1910, so he could not have been responsible for the 1925 Birthday Honours. This error stems from misinterpreting or misreading the information on the webpage. The correct monarch should have been King George V, who reigned from 1910 to 1936. The initial error in identifying the correct monarch led to an incorrect search for the birth year of King Edward VII.
